dict.string: WorkTime records your microphone together with system audio.
WorkTime records system audio so the other meeting participants are in the recording.
WorkTime asks your browser for the address of the front tab, for the local activity log. Nothing leaves this Mac.
WorkTime lets your iPhone read your meetings from this Mac over your local network when you turn on iPhone access. Nothing goes through a server.
WorkTime shows your reminders in the notch bar so you can tick them off and add new ones.
